description.value: You choose a point you can see within range. Every droid or construct in the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the start of each of its turns, a paralyzed target takes energy damage equal to twice your forcecasting ability modifier and repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 7
